summary: Configures an indexed HUD/feedback element: dereferences this to read a flag at *(this) + 0x32C8 that selects the gain source (flt_7CF35C when non-zero, flt_7CF338 plus an index increment of 1 when zero). Selects element result = this + 8*a2, writes gain = v6 * a4, writes magnitude a5, sets the byte at result+180 to 1, clamps the index v5 to [0, 3] (or 0 when negative), and clears the byte at result+196.
